hook.text: Robinhood eliminated stock trading commissions. Within five years, every major broker followed.

buildup.text: Before Robinhood, trading cost $7-10 per trade. The app launched in 2015 with free trades and a gamified interface.

discovery.text: Robinhood earns money from payment for order flow. Market makers pay Robinhood to route trades through them.

twist.text: During the 2021 GameStop frenzy, Robinhood restricted trading.

climax.text: Robinhood democratized trading but gamified it. Making investing feel like a game costs users who trade too often.

punchline.text: Free trades for everyone. But gamified investing costs users in other ways.

quiz.question: How does Robinhood make money without charging commissions?
options: Payment for order flow from market makers
